description: Retrieval corpus for the research dashboard's RAG comparison feature. Superset of the Phase 2-11 engineering pilot (configs/corpus/pilot_v1.json). Not legal gold and not a frozen benchmark; used only to build the local hybrid retrieval index over downloaded India Code PDFs.
